issue: मिथुन राशि राहु सुख गाढ़े: an astrological phrase; सुख may be the fourth house (sukha-bhāva).
our reading: Rāhu in Gemini stood firm in happiness.
alternatives: Rāhu in Gemini, strong in the house of happiness (the fourth house).

issue: शस्त्र विद्या देह सुयश कमावा: who earns the fame, the guru or the disciples of cau32.
our reading: By giving the science of weapons he (Paraśurāma) earned fair fame; the guru's glory spread to every horizon.
alternatives: The disciples, given the science of weapons, earned fame and spread their guru's glory.
Giving the wealth to Kaśyapa pleased him.

issue: पूर्णेन्दु निसि बासर स्वामी: पूर्णेन्दु as an epithet ('like the full moon') or the poet's name in a signature line.
our reading: Master like the full moon, dwell in the heart night and day.
alternatives: Lord, dwell night and day in the heart of Pūrṇendu (the poet).
